visual.name: bfusionFinancialKPINarrative
visual.description: Financial KPI cards with auto-generated narrative insights. Computes Budget Variance, Budget Consumed, Cost Performance Index, Forecast Alignment, Burn Rate, and Remaining Budget from project cost measures.

dataRoles.name: period
dataRoles.description: Time axis for trend-based narratives — supports Year > Quarter > Month drill hierarchy.

dataRoles.name: forecast
dataRoles.description: Forecast cost (optional). Enables Forecast Alignment KPI.

dataRoles.name: initialBudget
dataRoles.description: Original / baseline budget (optional). Enables Budget Drift KPI.

dataRoles.name: committed
dataRoles.description: Committed / encumbered cost (optional). Enables Commitment Coverage KPI.

dataRoles.name: periodDate
dataRoles.description: Bind a measure returning the first date of each period, e.g. Period Start = MIN(Calendar[Date]). Enables the Status Date cut-off.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

valueScale.description: Divide values by this factor for display.

totalPeriods.description: Total number of periods in the plan when the data holds fewer. 0 = use the loaded periods.

statusDate.description: Reporting cut-off. Periods starting on or before this date count as elapsed. Requires the Period Start Date field to be bound.

showStatusDatePicker.description: Show a date picker on the visual so report viewers can set the cut-off without the Format pane.

showVerdict.description: Full-width status verdict with headline and top action above the cards.

tolerancePct.description: Deviation from plan still treated as on plan. Drives the verdict and every card status.

eacMethod.description: How the estimate at completion is derived.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
